name: TourCoupon
en: English-language coupon discovery for visitors. Its guide says to open the coupon and show it to staff when paying. Check each shop’s coverage and conditions.
ko: 외국인용 영어 쿠폰 탐색 서비스입니다. 이용 가이드는 결제 시 쿠폰 사용 화면을 직원에게 제시하도록 안내합니다. 매장별 제공 지역과 조건을 확인하세요.
evidence: Public homepage and English how-to-use guide read. Individual restaurant coupon values were not available in the initial HTML; none were added to the coupon count.

name: VisitJeju · Tamnao
en: Jeju Tourism Organization’s link to Tamnao travel offers. Korean-language pages may include prepaid dining vouchers; check price, expiry and booking requirements at the provider.
ko: 제주관광공사 비짓제주의 탐나오 연결입니다. 한국어 페이지에서 식사권 등 여행 상품을 확인할 수 있습니다. 선결제 여부·가격·유효기간·예약 조건은 제공처에서 확인하세요.
evidence: Official page and Tamnao navigation were accessible. Product list is client-rendered in this response. Individual prices and discounts were not verified or counted.
